entries.description: New "By Server" and "By Trigger" charts show where your snipes are coming from at a glance. Hover a slice (or the legend) to see the exact count and its real/bait/timeout split.

entries.text: Right-click menu for Snipe History entries
entries.description: Quick actions on any entry: view details, jump to the message, copy the server link, join server, or remove it.
The new charts sit right below the overview cards, above the per-trigger list.
The detector now reads your Roblox logs more efficiently, avoiding unnecessary re-reads on every check.
No visible changes; just makes the plugin easier to maintain going forward.
Hover a trigger to reveal a drag handle on the left and reorder by dragging. Disabled while any search or filter is active.
Replaced the right-click action on triggers with a menu with quick actions like enable/disable, duplicate, export, etc.
Reorder triggers with ▲▼ buttons instead of dragging them, for anyone who prefers it.
Disable to go back to right-click instantly toggling enabled/disabled instead of opening the context menu.
Force-kill a running macro right after joining a snipe, before it can detect the biome and send a false alert to your macro's webhook.
Pick a known macro to auto-fill its kill target (Maxstellar, FishSol, Coteab, J.JARAM, SolsScope), or choose Custom to set your own.
Confirms whether the configured process name or window title actually matches something running, before you rely on it during a live snipe.
